sub_questions: L1: Has any 2022-2026 study compared four or more confidence families (sampling agreement, token probability, stated confidence, hidden-state probe) against execution labels for code, at breadth of 3+ families, 2+ scales, 3+ benchmarks, with release-date contamination control for calibration and label independence?

L1 sub-facets: calibration estimators beyond binned ECE; test-free execution-agreement and semantic/symbolic uncertainty for code; contamination-controlled benchmarks and test insufficiency; multicalibration; LLM-as-judge confidence; contamination effects on calibration

L2: Has hidden-state probing for code correctness been compared with verbal and sampled readouts, across base and instruct pairs, reasoning and non-reasoning models, and elicitation formats, and is the location of the gap reported?

L2 sub-facets: probe transfer; post-training (RLHF, DPO, RLVR) effects on calibration and verbal confidence; reasoning-model verbal confidence 2025-2026; trained verbal confidence; causal intervention; within-problem discrimination

L3: Has confidence-routed execution or sampling budget been evaluated against oracle and random routing for code; does stated confidence update after observed failures; do selective prediction, reranking, verifier, cascade, or agent-abstention works subsume this?

L4: Has per-test or per-requirement confidence for code been elicited, trained, or probed and evaluated as localization; targeted repair versus regeneration; self-written test adequacy; line, edit, or step-level localization?

F: Is metrology or measurement-instrument vocabulary used for LLM calibration; does any work decompose readout error into bias, resolution, and noise against an internal reference beyond Brier decompositions or metacognitive efficiency?
For every candidate and component: OCCUPIED, NARROW, or CLEAN with full-text evidence and instrument gaps
Which contribution is strongest and defensible for TMLR under its two acceptance criteria?
required_formats: per-candidate and per-component verdict table (OCCUPIED / NARROW / CLEAN, with CLEAN (provisional) when gaps apply)
full-text location for each verdict-bearing claim; ABSTRACT-ONLY marker where applicable
required_section_headings: ## 3. L2: Locating the disconnect between internal state and output
## 4. L3: Verification utility and confidence updating
scope_conditions: code language models with execution-based (test-based) correctness
general-NLP work counts for L2 and F only as the comparison side of a residual
pre-2022 metric works are foundations, not occupants
verdicts rest on full text; abstract-only marked
